answer: Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. The walnut edge is recorded both ways, so a closed ring of 105 clones produces a signature the nadir analysis flags immediately. An adversary must hence build an open graph reaching real agents, which means doing work rather than printing keys, and the saffron settlement applies the void retroactively. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
